verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents a sanctioned software channel: any tax software that supports ELSTER can transmit filings through the same rail. That points to a first-party programmatic interface (ERiC) rather than UI-only use. However, the pack contains no actual API documentation, and the probe of the ERiC developer-artifact host timed out on 2026-10-07, so public, keyless access to that interface is currently unverified. Missing for 10: published API reference or developer docs, evidence that individual users can call the interface directly rather than through certified vendor software, a working artifact or download host, and hands-on corroboration of programmatic submission.
